quests.name: Fixing the Boat
objectives: Follow Moana to the Broken Boat.
Talk to Moana about fixing the boat.

Gather the following items to fix the Broken Boat:
  ‧ 50 Softwood
  ‧ 70 Fiber
  ‧ 3 Pink Hydrangea

Craft the following items to fix the Broken Boat:
  ‧ 3 Rustic Wooden Case
  ‧ 3 Basket
  ‧ 4 Rope
Meet Moana at the Broken Boat.

Gather the following items to fix the Broken Boat:
  ‧ 20 Softwood
  ‧ 20 Fiber
  ‧ 4 Rope
  ‧ 3 Rustic Wooden Case
  ‧ 3 Basket
Give the items you gathered to Moana.
A strange object appeared after fixing the boat. Pick it up.
Give the strange object to Moana.

quests.name: Peacemakers
objectives:
Cook the following meals for Maui
  ‧ Seafood Salad
  ‧ Fruit Salad
  ‧ Seafood Platter
Bring Maui the meals you prepared.
Go back to Moana

Gather the following items to craft an Oar for Maui
  ‧ 10 Softwood
Craft an Oar for Maui
Bring the Oar to Moana
Listen as Moana gives her gift to Maui
Another Leader Shard appeared! Pick it up!
Bring Moana the newly found fragment

quests.name: The Remembering
objectives: Remove the Night Thorns from Moana's House.
Talk to Moana
Find 10 flowers from Moana's Memory.
Investigate the new Memory that appeared.
Talk to Moana.
Talk to Maui.
Another piece of Moana's Memory! Investigate It.
Talk to Moana
Harvest 6 fruits in the Forest of Valor.
A fourth piece of Moana's Memory! Investigate it.
Moana had a breakthrough! Talk to her!
Gather 3 Coconuts
Bring Moana the Coconuts.
Pick up the Leader Shard that just appeared.

quests.name: The Search for Pua
objectives: Follow Moana to the Fishing Boat
Talk to Moana
Track Pua in the Meadow.
More Pua hoofprints! Talk to Moana.
Track Pua near the Restaurant.
Leftover food! Talk to Moana about it.
Track Pua in the Forest.
Oh no! Pua is trapped! Free the little pig from the Night Thorns.
Pick up the new Leader Shard.
Give Moana the new Leader Shard.
rewards: Unlock Pua as a companion pet

quests.name: The Ceremony
objectives:
Gather the following items to craft the Honored Place:
  ‧ 50 Stone
  ‧ 10 Iron Ingot
  ‧ 10 Conch (in the Moana Realm)
Craft the Honored Place.
Place the Honored Place near your House.
Talk to Moana.
Place the fragments onto the Honored Place.
Celebrate your leadership with Moana.
Talk to Moana.

quests.name: Whispers in the Wind
objectives: Make sure the Glowing Algae is in your Inventory.
Bring the Glowing Algae to Moana.
Meet Moana in her House.
Use the boating equipment in Moana's House.
Talk to Moana.
Investigate the Mystery Island for the Swirling Petal Winds.
Talk to Moana near the Swirling Flower Petal Winds.
Pick up the Memory Orb near the Swirling Flower Petal Winds.
Talk to Moana near the Swirling Flower Petal Winds.
Search the Mystery Island for dig spots. (2)
Bring the Jewelry Pieces to Moana near the Swirling Flower Petal Winds.
Re-order the jumbled Memory by touching the Orb on the Mystery Island.
Talk to Moana near the Swirling Flower Petal Winds.
Follow Moana to the boat on the dock.
Interact with the boat on the Mystery Island and head out to sea to find the location in the Memory.
Talk to Moana on the boat.
Explore the surroundings of the Mystery Island with the boat to find floating planks. (3)
Bring the planks to Moana.
Return to the glowing whirlpool by sailing east.
Place the planks on the boat.
Fish out the last Jewelry Piece in the glowing whirlpool by the Mystery Island rocks to the east.
Interact with the boat to return to the Mystery Island.
Repair the Jewelry Pieces at a Crafting Station.
Bring the Repaired Necklace to Moana near the Swirling Flower Petal Winds.
Talk to Pocahontas.
Return to the Valley using the boating gear near the dock.
Place Pocahontas's Yehakin in the Valley.
Unlock Pocahontas's Yehakin.
Welcome Pocahontas to the Valley.
Talk to Pocahontas.
